'''''Fly Away''''' is the debut album of [[Christian hip hop|Christian rapper]], [[Paul Wright (rapper)|Paul Wright]].  It was released in 2003 by [[Gotee Records]].  Notable songs include "Your Love Never Changes", the first single from the album, and "West Coast Kid", which features [[Christians|Christian]] artist [[tobyMac]].  The musical style is original and has been described as acoustic [[Hip hop music|hip hop]].
